title: Rethinking Classifier-Free Guidance in On-Policy Diffusion Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. Existing OPD methods naturally extend velocity matching to the CFG-composed prediction, directly matching teacher and student guided velocities. summary_cn: A New Role for Relevance: Guiding Corpus Interaction in Agen：相关性是对文档或摘录是否包含有用证据的依赖于查询的估计。现有的检索代理使用相关性来选择 top-k 内容，但仅凭文档相关性无法定位、撰写或验证复杂问题所需的证据。
